function: Joint resource allocation of BS transmit beamforming, active-RIS element on/off, phase shift and amplification, RSMA common rate and UAV trajectory, maximizing energy efficiency (p. 7).
system: BS with N_BS = 3-11 antennas, eight single-antenna users, UAV-borne active RIS (UPA, M = 9-36 elements), RSMA downlink; carrier frequency value not given (pp. 4, 13).
method: Model-free DRL: modified-SAC (discrete element selection) plus TD3 (continuous variables), initialized by MAML meta-learning; reinforcement learning with meta-training then meta-adaptation (pp. 7, 11).
data_channel: Custom simulated Rician-fading BS-RIS and RIS-user channels with distance-based path loss; no 3GPP model, public dataset or measurement (pp. 4-5, 13).
test_conditions: Meta-training on tasks with different initial user locations; meta-adaptation on a new task with random user placement; sweeps of RIS size, BS power, antennas, QoS (pp. 11, 14-15).
baselines: Only DRL variants of the proposed scheme: MSAT without meta-learning, NOMA instead of RSMA, passive RIS, fixed terrestrial active RIS; no non-learned or earlier published method simulated (p. 14).
metrics: Mean reward, average energy efficiency and average sum rate (convergence); EE versus RIS elements, BS power, BS antennas and QoS threshold (pp. 13-15).
complexity: Big-O order of meta-training and meta-adaptation, in layer widths, batch size, episodes, time slots and tasks (Eqs. 53-54); no runtime, FLOPs or parameter count (p. 13).
openness: none; no code or data link, simulation parameters only in Table I (p. 14).
q1_support: p. 4: "on the basis of the Rician fading" (custom Rician model with distance path loss; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured channel is used or mentioned).
q2_support: p. 11: "a new task is defined with users placed randomly" and "initialized with the obtained parameters from the meta-training phase" (meta-adaptation to an unseen user placement).
q3_support: p. 14: "Proposed MSAT: This baseline corresponds to the Algorithm 1" and "Baseline 2: This baseline adopts meta-learning, modified-SAC, and TD3 with RSMA, however with passive RIS" (all schemes are DRL variants of the proposed method; no non-learned or earlier published learned baseline).
q4_support: p. 13: "we present the computational complexity of the proposed MMSAT resource management algorithm" (Big-O orders in Eqs. 53-54).
q5_support: p. 13: "is evaluated via numerical analysis" (own simulator with parameters in Table I, p. 14; no code or data link and no public channel dataset).
notes: Area 3 (BS precoder and RIS phases) also fits, but the link is an aerial UAV-borne RIS link with joint UAV trajectory, so the tie-break order picks area 6. q2 is borderline: the new task is a random user placement from the same distribution, no new band or scenario, but meta-adaptation to a new task is reported (p. 11). p. 3 claims superiority over the DRL schemes [16], [17], [38], but they are not simulated (p. 14), so q3 is 0.
